basis: Replacement name for Eriophyes euphorbiae Mohanasundaram, 1983; Mohammad-Doustaresharaf et al. 2023, Persian Journal of Acarology 12(1):81-89, print E. antiquorum Amrine & Stasny, 1994 (syn. E. euphorbiae Mohanasundaram, 1983); checked in the paper
Subgenus is Tylonychus Miller (Mahdavi et al. 2021, Systematic and Applied Acarology 26(3):557-567, use Mixonychus (Tylonychus) throughout); described as Tylonychus jayaraji, so authority in brackets
Xue & Zhang 2009, Zootaxa 2257:26 (Plazi treatment, doi 10.5281/zenodo.5317418) give Eriophyes alangii Nalepa, 1914; 1929 is Nalepa's later Marcellia catalogue
Replacement name for Tegolophus gmelinae Mohanasundaram, 1983 (junior homonym of T. gmelinus Das & Chakrabarti, 1982); IRMNG accepted name Tegolophus mohanasundarami Amrine & Stasny, 1994

Gupta & Karmakar 2015, Records of the Zoological Survey of India 115(1), entry 116 under Euseius: indica proposed in place of Amblyseius (Typhlodromalus) mangiferae Chatterjee & Gupta, 2003, a junior homonym of A. mangiferae Ghai & Menon, 1967. The checklist prints the original authors and year; who is credited with the replacement name needs a check
